summary: End-to-end verification of the new Hospice Eligibility Quick Check feature (backend + frontend) on top of the previously verified Spartan Coaching app. Added 5 new pytest cases for POST /api/eligibility/assess covering verdict accuracy (LIKELY/POSSIBLE/NOT_YET), validation, minimal input handling, and anonymous Mongo persistence — all 5 pass. Frontend (Expo Web, 420x900 mobile viewport) flow verified end-to-end: home lead-magnet card, 4-step questionnaire, AI summary generation, result card with verdict + share/talk-to-nick/restart actions, /tools first-position ordering, and full regression of all 5 tabs. 100% pass on all 23 review items.

issues: One residual console warning: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' — same cosmetic RN Web warning flagged in iteration_2. Non-blocking. Likely from a stray whitespace inside a <View> on eligibility.tsx (between siblings).

verified_flows: BACKEND POST /api/eligibility/assess (Dementia/FAST 7A/age 86/3 strong indicators/sepsis): 200 with verdict='LIKELY', summary mentions FAST + Medicare/LCD.
BACKEND POST /api/eligibility/assess (CHF/NYHA III/age 60/1 weak indicator): 200 with verdict in {POSSIBLE, NOT_YET}, never LIKELY.
BACKEND POST /api/eligibility/assess (Cancer only, no indicators): 200 with valid verdict + non-empty summary (>50 chars).
BACKEND POST /api/eligibility/assess with missing diagnosis: 422 validation error (Pydantic).
BACKEND Mongo eligibility_checks: inserts {verdict, diagnosis, indicators_count, created_at, id} only — no PII fields (name/email/phone/age/notes/recentEvents/patient_id).

FRONTEND Home / shows new home-eligibility-card between drill card and tools grid (drillY=540 < eligY=774 < toolY=1272). Card text: 'NEW · 60-SECOND TOOL', 'Hospice Eligibility Quick Check', '60 SECONDS / 10 DIAGNOSES / LCD ALIGNED', 'Start the check'.
FRONTEND /tools lists 'Eligibility Quick Check' as the FIRST card above 'Ask a Hospice Expert' (visually confirmed via screenshot).
FRONTEND Step 1: 11 diagnosis options (elig-dx-*), age input (elig-age). Dementia selection enables Next.
FRONTEND Step 2: 12 indicator checkboxes (elig-ind-*). At least 1 required to advance.
FRONTEND Step 3: Dementia -> FAST 7A-7F all 6 present (elig-scale-7A..7F). Switching diagnosis to CHF would show NYHA III/IV; PPS for others.
FRONTEND Step 4: elig-events textarea + summary card with 'READY TO ASSESS', Diagnosis/Scale/Indicators rows. elig-assess button present.
FRONTEND Submission shows loading 'Generating clinical summary…' state then transitions to result.

FRONTEND Result page: verdict label 'Likely Eligible' rendered, gradient verdict card, markdown summary mentioning FAST + Medicare/LCD, three buttons (elig-share, elig-talk-to-nick, elig-restart) all present and clickable.
FRONTEND 'Run another check' (elig-restart) resets to step 0 (elig-age visible, no diagnosis selected).
FRONTEND 'Talk to Nick about this case' (elig-talk-to-nick) navigates to /more with contact form visible.
FRONTEND 'Educational tool only. Not a clinical determination. Final hospice eligibility requires physician certification per Medicare guidelines.' compliance reminder shown at bottom of result.
REGRESSION Home/Method/Tools/Learn/More tabs all render correctly with expected content (Spartan, Discipline, Eligibility Quick Check, Knowledge, About).
REGRESSION No new React errors. Only the same pre-existing 'Unexpected text node' RN-Web warnings.
action_items: Optional cleanup (low priority, cosmetic): hunt down stray whitespace text nodes inside <View> children in eligibility.tsx (and chat/objection/playbook/knowledge from iteration_2). E.g., '{age && <SummaryRow ... />}' where age='' would render '' string inside <View>. Wrap in Boolean(age) guard or convert to: {age ? <SummaryRow .../> : null}.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly extracts verdict via regex and strips VERDICT: line from returned markdown — clean separation between machine-readable and display content.
eligibility_checks collection is properly PII-free (verdict + diagnosis + indicators_count + created_at only) — confirmed by direct Mongo query in test_eligibility_persists_anonymously.
POST /api/eligibility/assess gracefully handles minimal payload (diagnosis only) by defaulting age/scale/score to 'not specified' in the prompt — no 500s.
Frontend assessEligibility() in lib/api.ts is wired correctly to /api/eligibility/assess via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL).
Step gating logic (canProceed) is correct: requires diagnosis at step 0, ≥1 indicator at step 1, functionalScore at step 2.
Result page uses LinearGradient correctly per verdict (green/amber/gray) and renders markdown via react-native-markdown-display.
elig-restart clears all state (step, diagnosis, age, indicators, functionalScore, recentEvents) correctly.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 new eligibility tests pass; previous suite still green)

seed_data_creation: Several eligibility_checks records inserted via API during testing (anonymous, no PII).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Eligibility flow takes 4-10s for AI generation (GPT-4o-mini). Use generous waits when waiting for elig-share to appear post-submit. The diagnosis testid pattern is exactly elig-dx-{full diagnosis string including apostrophe}, e.g., elig-dx-Dementia / Alzheimer's. The indicator testid is elig-ind-{first 24 chars of indicator label} (not the full label) — better to select via [data-testid^='elig-ind-'] and pick by index. FAST/NYHA/PPS chips share the pattern elig-scale-{value}. First /eligibility navigation takes 5-15s for lazy bundle. /tools tool card data-testids (tool-card-*) are wrapped — query by visible order rather than relying on attribute selector.
rca of the issue: No defects. Eligibility Quick Check feature implementation is correct and fully integrated.
